## Gold-answer conflicts

Duplicates whose gold answers disagree after normalisation. Policy (see `fineval/splits.py`): cross-source disagreements keep the original publisher's answer and stay in the score; identical inputs with different answers inside one dataset are marked *ambiguous* and excluded from the primary score; conflicting training items are dropped.

| Task | Kind | Clusters |
|---|---|---|
| concept_tagging | same_input_different_gold | 7 |
| fact_extraction | same_input_different_gold | 13 |
| filing_qa | same_input_different_gold | 2 |
| terminology | same_input_different_gold | 6 |

Filing-QA disagreements (original vs copies):

- `financebench:open:test:financebench_id_00070`: no american water works had negative working capital of -1561m in fy 2022…
- `coling:domain_numeric:test:financebench_id_00070, xbrl_agent:financebench:test:financebench_id_00070`: yes american water works had postivie working capital of 124mn by fy 2022…
- `financebench:open:test:financebench_id_01107`: yes cvs health has been involved in multiple ongoing legal battles some notable legal dispute areas for cvs are -1 u…
- `coling:domain_numeric:test:financebench_id_01107, xbrl_agent:financebench:test:financebench_id_01107`: yes cvs health has been involved in multiple ongoing legal battles some notable legal dispute areas for cvs are -1 u…

## Leakage control

- Training items dropped: 12 × conflicting_gold, 3 × near_duplicate_of_eval_item.
- Near-duplicate pairs awaiting human review (`review/near_dups.csv`): 6 of 6. Until decided they are treated as possible duplicates for leakage purposes.
- Validation items from a filing that is also in the test set are flagged `filing_in_test`; few-shot selection never shows an example from the test item's own filing.
- FinTagging's release has no filing identifiers, so filing-level overlap between FinTagging and the COLING tag queries cannot be measured; text-level overlap is 0.
